name: StickbotDUO
summary:
Remote hosted ip server automates the local ip sharing.  StickbotDUO uses UDP to communicate with each other over the local router.

Manual ip entry is supported.
Clap hands above head to activate Arcade Mode, and enter each others ip's using the virtual keyboard. That's it, without internet, just a LAN router.

Tested with a low-cost portable pocket router.


Using StickbotDUO with a VPN to simulate a LAN WIFI across the internet: NOT TESTED

Multi-player mode works even without internet connection, manual
